title: Carl Sagan - Cosmos - Eratosthenes
summary: A short clip from Carl Sagan's Cosmos in which he explains how Eratosthenes measured the circumference of the Earth using shadows in two Egyptian cities. It is a clear, visual account of an ancient scientific feat.
why: HN commenters link it whenever the question of how the Earth's size was first measured comes up, calling it a wonderful explanation.
